mapper.select: SELECT product_code, product_name, insurance_type, product_status FROM product WHERE product_code = #{productCode}

SELECT request_id, product_code, requested_at, approved_at, is_approved, request_reason, submission_agency_name, authorization_status, product_description_file_name, terms_and_conditions_file_name, rate_schedule_file_name, product_evidence_file_name, revision_request, updated_at FROM product_authorization WHERE product_code = #{productCode} ORDER BY requested_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_authorization ( request_id, product_code, requested_at, approved_at, is_approved, request_reason, submission_agency_name, authorization_status, product_description_file_name, terms_and_conditions_file_name, rate_schedule_file_name, product_evidence_file_name, revision_request, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{requestId}, #{productCode}, #{requestedAt}, #{approvedAt}, #{isApproved}, #{requestReason}, #{submissionAgencyName}, #{authorizationStatus}, #{productDescriptionFileName}, #{termsAndConditionsFileName}, #{rateScheduleFileName}, #{productEvidenceFileName}, #{revisionRequest}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE product_authorization SET authorization_status = #{authorizationStatus}, is_approved = #{isApproved}, approved_at = #{approvedAt}, revision_request = #{revisionRequest}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE request_id = #{requestId}
